name: pre-retraining fixed-policy CPU baseline
split_boundaries: Historical train stays unchanged and unused; dev/calibration and Ubin excluded from heldout. Test has 99 canonical-family scenarios plus 11 Southern corridor voyages. Historical canonical eleven are previously inspected regression fixtures, excluded from training/tuning; no claim that developers never saw them.

sample_size.selection: Pilot n=2 per fixed policy is insufficient to estimate population variance reliably. Use conservative Bernoulli variance upper bound .25, nominal 95% half-width .10: ceil(1.96^2*.25/.10^2)=97. Apply mandatory minimum100 and balanced family/geographic allocation to choose110. Achieved intervals may be wider; no significance or outcome stopping.
sample_size.limitations: Eight nearby perturbations per canonical family are physically distinct but related. Scenario bootstrap is conditional on this exploratory mixture, not proof of independent encounter-family/geographic sampling.

targets.denominator: All110 scenarios per arm, including9 deliberate planning failures. Unknown collision metrics on non-executed failures are counted as no observed collision and reported separately; not evidence of safe completion. Targets assess controllers, not software acceptance.

metric_rules.success: status == success, final goal within .5 model units; elapsed excludes failure completion times
metric_rules.collision: any swept ship or land collision flag; failure without frames is unknown, separately counted
metric_rules.domain: truth clearance below1 physical metre, actual interval durations
metric_rules.reference: Each scenario reference_route above is A* plus smoothing on frozen map at map_options resolution/clearance. Same reference for every variant. NoPath unreachable family has null reference; no invented route or numerical score. Cross-track uses shortest distance to frozen polyline; detour = travelled/reference length.
metric_rules.units: Physical distances metres and duration seconds via scale.units. Model-normalized elapsed/distance/tracking separately retained; detour dimensionless. Mixture means explicitly conditional on corpus; Southern physical means separate.
metric_rules.rates: Marine violations use .35 rad/model second and .2 speed/model second bounds, initial rest and navigation-leg heading; holonomic tier separately labelled.

comparison_rules: Only listed pairs are inferential comparisons. All preserve frozen traffic/random seed. marine_sarl and marine_mpc share marine dynamics, filter on, exact sensing, uncertainty on, A* goals. Dynamics tiers are descriptive, not a policy ablation. Other named pairs change exactly the stated switch; degraded sensing is a joint noise/delay/dropout intervention.

inference.method: shipnav.metrics.paired_interval, A minus B, scenario-paired percentile bootstrap
inference.primary_eligibility: Every scenario in both arms, failed outcomes retained; missing/duplicate arm blocks final summary until recovered or explicitly represented as error.
inference.secondary_eligibility: Completion time, reference detour, reference tracking: include scenario jointly only when both arms succeed AND both fields are finite. Report excluded scenario IDs and pair count; never delete one arm alone. These conditional comparisons may select easier cases.
inference.multiplicity: Exploratory unadjusted intervals, no confirmatory significance or superiority claims.
inference.training_replication: Single supplied checkpoint is one fixed policy. No training-seed uncertainty claim. Future learned comparisons require >=3 (prefer5) independent training seeds, publish each seed and hierarchical_interval resampling training seeds then scenarios.

run_order.rule: Random(9127).shuffle(manifest test entries); rotate insertion-order VARIANTS by scenario ordinal modulo12; one process, serial arms. Observer/exogenous seeds are scenario.seed. Preserve completed rows on infrastructure resume.

stopping.rule: Exactly110*12 completed records; no favorable-outcome stopping and no post-freeze tuning. Retain all failures/errors/traces. Infrastructure interruption pauses and resumes same schedule, with attempts disclosed; no replacing a failed arm to improve outcomes.
stopping.episode_limit: Shared per-scenario limit below: synthetic100 model seconds; scaled max(100,3*frozen reference length), identical for every variant. No planner-dependent budget.
stopping.disk: Before each unit require400 MiB headroom. Compress each completed raw JSON unit deterministically losslessly, retain raw and stored SHA256. Never delete prior user evidence.

timing.cold_instance: decision1 of each newly constructed policy instance; process/import/library caches may be warm
timing.warmed: decision6 onward; operational label, not convergence proof
timing.inference: policy call wall time, including adapter/fallback; no-neighbour direct fallback is not neural inference
timing.full_decision: observation + policy + prediction + filter decision loop wall time; excludes dynamics integration, scoring, planning, model loading, export and process startup
timing.deadline: configured .25 model seconds * scale.units time scale *1000; compare both inference and decision to physical budget, not partial terminal tick
timing.conditions: No parallel acceptance/policy jobs during heldout timing. Pilot overlapped tooling tests and is exploratory. No claim of isolated operating-system load or process-cold timing.
timing.cuda_future: Before any future asynchronous CUDA timing synchronize before and after measured work; no CUDA results here.

supersedes_before_any_heldout_run.reason: Shared frozen reference timeout for all planner arms; no heldout outcomes observed.
